blocks.title: KimMod
blocks.tagline: ModLoader mod for TrackMania Nations and United Forever with quality-of-life features and a much faster physics engine.

items.title: Faster physics
items.text: The physics engine is optimized for replay validation and bruteforce; the main loop can run at maximum speed.

items.title: Mass validation
items.text: Validation can run in several instances at once and shows progress in the window title.

items.title: Replay menu
items.text: A replay menu with mouse-button navigation and undo/redo.

items.title: Quality of life
items.text: Quality-of-life improvements and other game optimizations.

blocks.title: Requirements
blocks.markdown: KimMod needs the TrackMania ModLoader and a CPU with AVX support. It runs on Windows and on Linux with Wine. The changelog on the mod page lists support for Competition Patch, Highlands and NewSnowCar in recent versions.

blocks.title: Credits
blocks.markdown: KimMod is published at home.koyaanis.com. The page does not name the author; the description follows that page (version 1.0.3-v7, January 2026).
